initial_assembly_order: Prepare fixed carriers, BUS mounting and all inaccessible fastener stacks before crossing wires.
Mount BUS with USB-C already mated and its jacket independently restrained; do not assume later axial access through its fixed pad.
Complete the stationary GPIO housing clamp on bench before surrounding RR/AUX harness. Keep its five wires correctly mapped and restrained; W009 may remain installed.
Lower supported Pi/upper frame onto the stationary GPIO housing using the reverse received release path; USB-A remains withdrawn and supported.
Seat/retain upper carrier, mate USB-A with the reverse sidebow path and restore one main-saddle tie; no removable near-plug arm. Selected plug dimensions remain a fit gate.
Mate Pi power using the separately qualified complete-wire sequence; this sequence is still OPEN. Verify wire identities and neighbours before closure.
Close panels only after shared tool access and reversible cable parking are qualified.
